NexusPay
API Reference v1.0

Integrate NexusPay

Build powerful payment experiences with our robust REST API. Connect your application to the Nexus gateway in minutes.

Authentication

Secure your requests with API keys

All API requests must include your X-API-KEY and X-API-SECRET in the headers.

Header NameValue Type
X-API-KEYString
X-API-SECRETString

Manage your keys in the dashboard settings.

Headers Example
curl -X POST https://nexus.adityathakur.tech \
  -H "X-API-KEY: your_api_key" \
  -H "X-API-SECRET: your_api_secret" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"

Create Payment Link

Generate a new payment session

POST/api/gateway/create-order

Request Body

amountRequired

The transaction amount as a decimal value.

Decimal
descriptionOptional

Brief purpose or note for the payment.

String
returnUrlOptional

URL to redirect user after payment is processed.

URL

Success Response

{
  "success": true,
  "url": "https://nexuspay.com/pay?q=...",
  "orderId": "ord_123456"
}

Check Order Status

Verify payment completion

GET/api/gateway/order-status/{orderId}

Path Parameters

orderIdRequired

The unique identifier for the order to check.

Path

Sample Response

{
  "orderId": "ord_123456",
  "status": "PAID",
  "amount": 500.00,
  "paidAt": "2026-04-26T02:40:00"
}
